prompt: 부분 환불 회귀 차단: (a) PaymentRepositoryPort 시그니처에 proportionalCredits + isPartial 박제 (b) prisma-payment.repository에 ratio + Math.floor(credits * ratio) + payment.amount 조회 + refundedAmount > payment.amount validation (c) Payment.status 'partial_refunded' / 'refunded' 분기 (d) refund-payment.usecase 4 action 매트릭스 (refund_normal/_deficit/_partial/_partial_deficit) + refundedAmount <= 0 BadRequestException (e) spec 부분 환불 describe ≥6 it (f) sensor-partial-refund.sh 신설 (g) shared-contracts §17 PartialRefund 박제. 회귀 시 즉시 FAIL.
